scope: 编译、打包与字节摘要核对；无测试、业务操作或服务启动
packagedDisabledConfig:
# 所有外部动作默认关闭；不定义另一数据源，不执行迁移，不分配端口。
paismart:
  enabled: false
  upload:
    max-file-bytes: 536870912
  object-store:
    enabled: false
    writes-enabled: false
    probe-enabled: false
    endpoint: ''
    bucket: ''
    access-key-secret-ref: platform.paismart.minio.access-key
    secret-key-secret-ref: platform.paismart.minio.secret-key
  jobs:
    kafka-enabled: false
    bootstrap-servers: ''
    security-protocol: SSL
    allow-plaintext: false
    sasl-mechanism: SCRAM-SHA-512
    jaas-secret-ref: platform.paismart.kafka.jaas
    truststore-location: ''
    truststore-password-ref: platform.paismart.kafka.truststore
    memory-high-water: 0.85
    memory-low-water: 0.70
  intelligence:
    external-calls-enabled: false
    allow-http: false
    allowed-hosts: ''
    contextual-enabled: false
    rerank-enabled: false
    rerank-threshold: '0.2'
    citation-verification-enabled: false
    conflict-llm-confirmation-enabled: false
    elasticsearch:
      endpoint: ''
      secret-ref: platform.paismart.elasticsearch.api-key
      analyzer: standard
    parse:
      process-enabled: false
      worker-classpath: ''
      pdf-engine: pdfbox
      liteparse-command: ''
      ocr-enabled: false
      ocr-language: chi_sim+eng
      ocr-callback-base: ''
      concurrency: 2
      max-bytes: 104857600
      max-pages: 1000
      max-characters: 4194304
      timeout-seconds: 300
    ocr:
      aliyun-enabled: false
      secret-ref: ai.paismart.aliyun.ocr
    chunk:
      size: 1000
      overlap: 100
      min-size: 100
    parent-context:
      max-characters: 16000
    chat:
      allowed-origins: ''
      max-output-tokens: 4096
    eval:
      human-sample-rate: '0.2'
  payment:
    enabled: false
    merchant-id: ''
    app-id: ''
    serial: ''
    notify-url: ''
    private-key-alias: platform.paismart.payment.private-key
    api-v3-alias: platform.paismart.payment.api-v3
  operations:
    execute-enabled: false
    legacy-source:
      enabled: false
      endpoint: ''
      bucket: ''
      access-key-secret-ref: platform.paismart.minio.access-key
      secret-key-secret-ref: platform.paismart.minio.secret-key
